title: Chapter 1310 - 49: Lin Yuan And The Eternal Lords
content:
Chapter 1310 - 49: Lin Yuan And The Eternal Lords

Chapter 1310: Chapter 49: Lin Yuan and the Eternal Lords

Lin Yuan smiled.

The Eternal Lords can observe numerous future timelines; many things cannot be concealed from them.

"Originally, we were almost in despair, having observed billions of future timelines, and the final result in all of them was the Demon God destroying everything." The Master of Wushan looked at Lin Yuan with a complicated expression.

Only in a few timelines did the Fang Yuan World give birth to a new Eternal Lord, but compared to the countless timelines they observed, those few timelines had too low a probability.

Even they, as beings of time, felt despair.

"But your appearance, my young friend, has entirely ended the ’demon’ disaster, saving all beings in this world." The Master of Infinite said.

"I haven’t yet ended the demon disaster; the Demon God still exists, and the Demonic Qi hasn’t stopped its erosion." Lin Yuan immediately said.

Although he had repelled the Demon God, it was more like the Demon God retreated on its own, finding it meaningless to fight Lin Yuan, and instead focused on suppressing the consciousness of the Source World.

"It’s only a matter of time." The Master of Infinite said.

The other twelve Eternal Lords heard this and none of them refuted.

During this time, they observed one timeline after another and found that Lin Yuan was almost destined to become an Eternal Lord, making the end of the demon disaster indeed only a matter of time.

"Only a matter of time?"

Lin Yuan understood in his heart, knowing that the thirteen time beings must have watched his future timelines.

And indeed, once Lin Yuan ascends to the thirteenth stage, the first thing he will do is surely clear away the Demonic Qi and eradicate the Demon God.

In Lin Yuan’s eyes, the Fang Yuan World is akin to his base, and in such circumstances, he naturally doesn’t want there to be unstable factors, like the Demonic Qi and the Demon God.

Lin Yuan’s main reason for ending the demon disaster is for himself.

As for saving all beings? It happens along the way.

"But young friend, there is something else you need to pay attention to."

The Master of Infinite looked at Lin Yuan, "You don’t need to provoke that Demon God for now; wait until you reach the thirteenth stage and then take action."

In many of the future timelines observed by the Master of Infinite, the time it takes for Lin Yuan to become an Eternal Lord ranges from ten thousand years to one hundred thousand years.

Why would Lin Yuan in a certain timeline ascend to the thirteenth stage after a hundred thousand years? It is because, in that timeline, Lin Yuan attempted to end the demon disaster and suppress the Demon God before reaching the thirteenth stage.

The result was a fierce resistance from the Demon God, and in the ensuing battle, Lin Yuan suffered some effects, his mind and will being eroded to a certain extent.

Although it was not a major problem, it took tens of thousands of years to completely eliminate this erosion.

These are all things the Master of Infinite saw from future timelines, knowing what Lin Yuan might do in the future, and naturally, he immediately reminded him to avoid continuing down the wrong path.

"Yes, young friend."

"There’s no rush to eliminate the demon disaster; that Demon God wants to completely suppress the consciousness of the Source World? It’s still far off, no rush, no rush."

"Yes, first ascend to the thirteenth stage and become an Eternal Lord, then talk."

The Master of Wushan and the Master of Black Space said one after another.

The strength of a thirteenth-stage time being lies in being able to choose the future most advantageous to oneself.

"Oh?"

Lin Yuan felt a slight movement in his heart.

Currently, he can also observe future timelines, but it’s far from what a true time being can do, and he didn’t see the timeline where he takes action against the Demon God early.

"Understood."

Lin Yuan nodded.

He indeed has thoughts of seeking out the Demon God for further sparring, of course, just thoughts, without any concrete plans to implement them.

But with the reminders from the Eternal Lords, Lin Yuan immediately realized that this approach might carry a price.

"You, young friend, are indeed powerful, almost not much weaker than us, but after all, you’re not a time being; with only straightforward offensive capabilities, it’s easy to be calculated against when facing those powerful time beings."

The Master of Infinite said, "Only by becoming an Eternal Lord, not only can you see more possible futures, but you can also avoid other time beings from peering into you."

"To peer into the future of an existence that is not a time being, and to peer into the future of a time being, the difficulty is worlds apart."

The Master of Infinite said.

Unless the power difference is too great, it’s difficult for beings of the same level of time to directly observe each other’s clear future timelines, typically deducing through indirect observation.

Once reaching the level of a Time Lord, one begins to collect and seal their own timeline, turning it into their domain, completely preventing other time beings from spying.

And reaching the fourteenth stage level, one jumps out of the timeline altogether, leaving no traces in the past, present, or future.

"Hmm..."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Theoretically, other time beings wouldn’t dare to plot against Lin Yuan’s future at all.

But what if an accident occurs? With the means of time beings, it’s not easy to plot against someone, but once they start plotting, it indicates they have a fairly good chance.

"Only by becoming an Eternal Lord, becoming a time being, do you have the qualification to attempt to explore a multitude of dimensional spaces and compete with the time beings of other dimensions."

The Master of Black Space said.

...

In the time that followed.

The thirteen Eternal Lords conversed with Lin Yuan one after another.

The friendliness in their words almost overflowed.

Lin Yuan knew this well and was happy to see it.

It’s always better to have another friend than another enemy.

Even if Lin Yuan ascends to the thirteenth stage and becomes a time being, he is happy to make friends with other time beings.

"Young friend, having fought with the Demon God, what do you think?"

The Master of Black Space asked.

"Very powerful."

Lin Yuan said.

The Demon God is indeed very powerful.

Without using any Secret Techniques or Divine Skills, relying solely on physical instinct to fight with Lin Yuan head-on.

Moreover, Lin Yuan faintly speculated afterward that the Demon God he fought against was not in its peak state.

Part of the Demon God’s power transformed into endless Demonic Qi, spreading throughout the entire Source World.

The Demon God’s true peak state is after gathering all the Demonic Qi.

But when the Demonic Qi is gathered, it cannot continue to erode the Source World.

"Are you curious about the origin of the Demon God, young friend?" The Master of Black Space looked at Lin Yuan.

"The Demon God is the Black Demon body of the Lord of Heaven Light?" Lin Yuan directly said.

As soon as he said this, the other Eternal Lords were slightly surprised.

Regarding the true identity of the Demon God, only these Eternal Lords knew.

Life below the Eternal Lord level was completely unaware, only knowing that the Demon God was one of the sources of the demon disaster.

"Have you already comprehended the legacy left by the Lord of Heaven Light, young friend?" The Master of Wushan’s thoughts flashed, receiving critical information from the test space he had constructed.

The Lord of Heaven Light had two true bodies, the Bright Body and the Black Demon Body.

All along, the Lord of Heaven Light had shown only the Bright Body to the outside world.

As for the Black Demon Body? Before the great change in the world occurred, even some of the Eternal Lords were unaware of it.

The Black Demon Body was one of the hidden means of the Lord of Heaven Light, only mentioned in a few created legacies.

"That legacy, have you comprehended it, young friend?"

The Eternal Lords, including the Master of Infinite, looked surprised, as many of them hadn’t fully comprehended it.

But thinking of Lin Yuan’s almost certain future, and his current strength comparable to a standard Eternal Lord, the time beings present immediately understood.

On Lin Yuan, no matter how unbelievable it seemed, it appeared quite normal.

"Yes, the Demon God is indeed the Black Demon Body of the Lord of Heaven Light..." The Master of Black Space said with emotion.

The other Eternal Lords also fell silent.

All these Eternal Lords had more or less received favors from the Lord of Heaven Light.

"Why did the Lord of Heaven Light become like this?" Lin Yuan looked at the thirteen Eternal Lords and asked his lingering doubt.

As the Black Demon Body of the Lord of Heaven Light, the Demon God has no mind or will, and as for the Bright Body of the Lord of Heaven Light, it probably also lacks mind or will, otherwise, the thirteen Eternal Lords alone couldn’t hold back the most powerful Bright Body.

And if it were the normal Lord of Heaven Light, wanting to destroy this Source World, it could have acted entirely at the beginning of the world’s creation when the Lord of Heaven Light was the only Eternal Lord.

"Hmm, the Lord of Heaven Light..."

The Master of Infinite looked at Lin Yuan with surprise in his eyes, "That, young friend, has to be told from a long, long time ago."
